sections.appearance: Satsuki has yellow eyes and messy, waist-length pink hair with bangs that frame her face. Her hair rests on her shoulders, reaching below her neck. Additionally, she has red and black hartebeest-like horns. Albeit not visible at first glance, a very short heart-spaded tail hides under her skirt. She has two sharp, vampire-like fangs. Halo ==== Her halo is formed by a dark red eight-sided star that fades into black upwards, with teardrop-like elements pointing inwards. Uniform ==== Satsuki wears a black short dress which reveals her cleavage and has two opening at the thighs. She also wears a little red tie, a black military coat with golden accents, red thigh-high socks and knee-length black boots. Firearm ==== She uses a black Mauser M712 "Schnellfeuer" pistol with a red barrel, magazine, and grips. The hammer, magazine release catch, and trigger is painted brown. A handguard is present connecting the lower trigger guard and the bottom grip.

sections.personality: Satsuki is generally a manipulative loser whose methods of 'manipulation' are rather childish and perhaps even somewhat naive. Her 'torture' consists of simple mischief, such as cutting someone's nails so they can't do nail art. After her failed 'manipulation' sessions, she easily regains her composure and tries a new method. Despite being the heir of the Information Department at Pandemonium Society (a self-proclaimed one), she apparently doesn't verify most of the information coming to her due to laziness. Her hypnosis methods seem to work only on her for some reason. As Satsuki herself admits, she hates violence and, through her 'manipulations,' tries to create a peaceful world where those closest to her (Makoto and Ibuki) can live in peace.
